content:
**issue #509 — brain:promote slice 2: in-place amendment promotion, byte-identical to be2d143**

**Actor:** claude-opus-5 (agente)
**Fuente:** issue #509 / branch feat/issue-509-promote-amendments

WHAT SHIPPED
`brain:promote` now takes a second draft shape: `*.draft.md` + one fenced `brain-amendment/1`
block = an in-place amendment to an already-signed brain/** file. New pure module
`brain/scripts/lib/amendment-draft.mjs` (contract parser + total planner); `runPromote` dispatches
between two planners and keeps ONE copy of each ADR-0028 lock. `promote-529.sh` and
`promote-516.sh` deleted; a test keeps them deleted.

THE CONTRACT (the design question the ticket asked to settle)
The draft declares CONTENT, the verb generates SHAPE. Scalars: target, amendment, issue,
home-summary, body, body-end. §1c act 2 = ordered `amend-find`/`amend-replace` fence pairs
(exact strings, refuse on any count != 1 — both stopgaps' property, kept). The verb generates the
Status line (and VERIFIES the amendment number is target's+1), the DD/MM/YYYY stamps, the
`**Signed**:` line, the brain/HOME.md marker, and the AGENTS.md regeneration. `.draft.md` is
REQUIRED in addition to the contract block, so a doc that merely quotes a contract is never
promotable. Unknown contract keys refuse.

THE ORACLE
`be2d143` (ADR-0026 Amendment 2, promoted by hand). Test:
brain/scripts/brain-promote.golden.test.mjs — builds a repo from the tree at be2d143^, assembles
the draft from the pre-existing #473 draft (prose + act-2 annotation) plus the PRE target (the
anchor), runs the verb, asserts the ADR file, brain/HOME.md and AGENTS.md are BYTE-IDENTICAL to
be2d143, zero commits, three staged paths, and the printed commit command passes the real
commit-msg hook. Verified: the #473 draft's signed section is already byte-identical to what
be2d143 appended once `**Signed**:` is stamped.

RED-PROOF (6 mutations, each read back off disk before running)
M1 act 2 skipped -> RED; M2 act 1 status line computed-not-applied -> RED; M3 HOME.md marker not
written -> RED; M4 AGENTS.md regeneration skipped -> RED; M5 ISO instead of DD/MM/YYYY -> RED;
M6 non-literal String.replace ($& expands) -> RED. All restored, md5 verified.

THINGS FOUND THAT ARE NOT IN THE TICKET
1. The #473 draft's act-2 paste block is LINE-WRAPPED prose; the ADR carries that annotation on
   ONE line inside a table row. The human unwrapped it by hand. A prose draft could not have been
   applied verbatim by any tool — that is the concrete case for a machine-readable contract.
2. Idempotence needs the STOPGAPS' key, not an anchor count: an anchor that is a PREFIX of its own
   replacement ("## Lockout Recovery" -> "## Lockout Recovery (amended ...)") still occurs exactly
   once after the edit lands, so an anchor-count check alone double-applies. Found by a real
   double-apply. The check is "every declared replacement already present".
3. compileAgentsMd's `?? ''` fail-open now THROWS on any missing SOURCE_DOCS key (array included).
   init() never relied on it. A test shows why it was invisible: the gutted output has the same
   banner and the same five section headers as a good one.
4. AGENTS.md is always recompiled but only WRITTEN when it differs — a target outside the five
   SOURCE_DOCS compiles to identical bytes, and staging a no-op reports a path the human cannot
   find in `git diff --cached`.

WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE
No gate. #516's content-keyed amendment-marker check is buildable and unbuilt — the verb is the
net only for promotions that go through the verb; a hand-run amendment is exactly as unguarded as
before (design D5). No commit, no push. One target per run.

TIER 2 — NOT PROMOTED
Two amendment drafts under openspec/changes/issue-509-promote-amendments/brain-drafts/, both
written in the new contract format and both DRY-RUN against a throwaway copy of the real tree:
adr-0028-amendment-1.draft.md (ADR-0028's slice-1 scope paragraph is now stale) and
consolidation-protocol-amendment.draft.md (§1c/§1d say "until #509 ships"). The human promotes
them by running `npm run brain:promote -- <draft>`; their commit is the signature.

RESIDUAL
The golden oracle lives in git history and CI's local-checks checks out at depth 1. The suite
tries one bounded `git fetch --depth=2 origin be2d143`, then reports SKIP with the exact command
— never a pass. It ran live here (13/13). Counted diff: 990 of the lite budget's 1000.
